title: PS-1464-1A
text:
PS-1464-1A  Council District: 11 – Park
  CEQA: ENV-2023-6735-MND-REC1  Last Day to Act: 08-05-26
  Plan Area: Palms – Mar Vista – Playa Del Rey  Continued from 07-01-26

  PUBLIC HEARING REQUIRED

  PROJECT SITE:  5000, 5927, 5298 and 5300 South Beethoven Street

  PROPOSED PROJECT:
  A Private Street to provide legal frontage and street access for the parcels at 5000 South Beethoven Street
  in conjunction with the construction, use, and maintenance of a new private access bridge over Centinela
  Creek, connecting the parcels to the existing public roadway system via Beethoven Street.

  APPEAL:
  An appeal of the April 24, 2026, Advisory Agency’s Determination which:
  1. Found, based on the independent judgment of the decision-maker, after consideration of the whole of
  the administrative record, the project was assessed in Mitigated Negative Declaration No. MND-97-
  0348-ZC-GPA-HD-SPR adopted on September 9, 1998; and pursuant to CEQA Guidelines 15162 and
  15164, as supported by the addendum No. ENV-2023-6735-MND-REC1 dated October 2025, no major
  revisions are required to the Mitigated Negative Declaration; and no subsequent EIR or negative
  declaration is required for approval of the project;
  2. Approved, pursuant to Chapter 1 Article 8 of the Los Angeles Municipal Code, a Private Street approval
  to provide a legal frontage and street access for the parcels at 5000 South Beethoven Street in the
  Palms – Mar Vista – Del Rey Community Plan, as shown on the map stamp-dated December 9, 2025;
  and
  3. Adopted the Conditions of Approval and Findings.

  Applicant:  Ilan Israely, 5000 Beethoven LLC
  Representative: Athena Novak, AHN and Associates

  Appellant:  Defend Ballona Wetlands
  Representative: Marcia Hanscom and Robert J. van de Hoek

  Staff:  Kenton Trinh, City Planner
  kenton.trinh@lacity.org
  (213) 482-7092
summary: Appeal of Advisory Agency's approval of a Private Street to provide legal frontage and street access for parcels at 5000 South Beethoven Street, including construction of a private access bridge over Centinela Creek.
